description: Output of a real cross-version run: two stellar/quickstart networks, protocol 27 and 28, the bundled preflight.config.yml and its four example contracts.
image: stellar/quickstart:latest (not recorded in the report; this run predates the --image option)
imageNote: Docker Hub's tag list shows v672-b1475.1-latest (published 2026-09-29T12:31Z) was the `latest` tag from then until 2026-10-06T02:16Z, so that is almost certainly the image this run used. This is inferred from tag timestamps, not read from the run. On the current `latest`, protocol 27 no longer runs (see the README).
notes: Files are the unmodified workflow artifacts, copied byte for byte.
An earlier run (run 37380720125, before the ledger-protocol check existed) produced identical numbers.
Costs are RPC simulateTransaction estimates for tiny example contracts, not on-ledger metered costs.
The cause of the 5.8% to 8.9% instruction decrease has not been traced.
